title: veg_lasagna
howToPrepare:
Ingredients:

         2 tbsp extra-virgin olive oil

        1 medium yellow onion, chopped

        garlic powdered or paste

        1 medium zucchini, cubed

        1 medium eggplant, cubed

        1 medium carrot shredded

        2 crushed tomatoes

        1 tbsp dried oregano

        1 tbsp sugar
        ½ tsp red pepper flakes

        Salt and black pepper to taste

        lasagna noodles (about 6–8 sheets

        2 cups of shredded mozzerella cheese

        Your preferred veg toppings

        How to prepare :To make this lasagna, start by preheating your oven to 350°F and heating a splash of olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Toss in a chopped onion, three minced garlic cloves, a diced zucchini, a cubed eggplant, six ounces of sliced mushrooms, and a diced carrot, sautéing for about 10 minutes until soft before stirring in five ounces of baby spinach until it wilts. Next, pour a 28-ounce can of crushed tomatoes straight into those vegetables, season it all with a tablespoon of dried oregano, a pinch of sugar, red pepper flakes, salt, and pepper, and let this complete veggie sauce simmer on low for 20 minutes. To assemble, grab an 8x8 baking dish and spread a little of this chunky veggie sauce on the bottom, then lay down your oven-ready lasagna noodles. Layer on a third of the remaining veggie sauce, dollops of ricotta cheese, and a handful of shredded mozzarella, repeating these layers two more times until you use up your noodles, sauce, 12 ounces of ricotta, and two cups of mozzarella. Finally, cover the dish tightly with foil, bake for 25 minutes, take the foil off for another 15 to 20 minutes until the cheese is bubbling and golden, and let it rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
